subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw trust and merge these updated third-party Action revisions in workflows that handle secrets, tokens, write permissions, security results, or publishing access?
rationale: CI can demonstrate workflow execution but cannot decide whether the repository should trust newly pinned upstream code at privileged boundaries.

options.title: Approve after provenance review
options.body: Refresh the head, verify each SHA and material release delta, and merge only after affected exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Land low-privilege setup actions separately and review token, Codex, Docker, CodeQL, labeling, and stale actions in narrower batches.

options.title: Decline the grouped batch
options.body: Replace or close the grouped update if owners cannot validate the combined privileged execution surface.

recommendation.title: Approve after provenance review
recommendation.body: Refresh the head, verify each SHA and material release delta, and merge only after affected exact-head checks pass.
